[Discussion] What games have storylines that tied up neatly in the end with no sequel hook and yet left good potential for a sequel in the future?

Sleeping Dogs.

The triad crime genre is rife with potential and Sleeping Dogs was great. Another story in the same vein with different characters would be great.

That's my problem with a Sleeping Dogs sequel. I really loved the game and the world it created but where do you go from there? It wrapped up so neatly. I suppose you could do a new game from a different perspective. Maybe you play as an actual member of the triad and it deals with how the triad recovered from Wei's antics.
Max Payne 1. New York is still a crime infested hellhole, but Max Payne did get his revenge on the person who killed his wife + daughter.

Red Dead Redemption. John Marston was redeemed. Industrialization is still coming to end life as we know it in the West.

LA Noire. Cole Phelps and Jack Kelso cracked the case. There is still police corruption and organized crime in LA (and cities around the world) to this day.
Dishonored did a great job and the richness of the setting and world was never fully explored, and definitely not something easy to do in just one game. Can't wait for the sequel.

I like to think the first Sly Cooper did this well. He got the girl completed the thievious raccoonus and then made his escape with the gang.

Come to think of it, while the endings of some Sly games are bitter sweet they all always end with a feeling of accomplishment.
Enslaved was neat. A Big Question gets answered, but the game gives you no information about the main characters' histories or what's going on outside the West.
